items.title: American Express’s CEO Sold $99 Million of Stock the Day Before the Crash
items.summary: A nine-figure stock sale landed one day before a $2.5 trillion tech rout, and the timing looks damning. The filing details, a precedent from earlier years, and one unchecked box on the form complicate the story.

items.title: American Express vs. PayPal: Which Stock Does Wall Street Expect to Grow Faster Through 2027?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAnalysts expect American Express’s normalized EPS to rise 31% from 2025 to 2027, against 11% for PayPal. American Express’s higher forward P/E is backed by that faster growth, which makes it the better buy of the two today.

items.title: American Express (AXP) Could Be 27% Below Fair Value After Raised 2026 Outlook
items.summary: American Express (AXP) is back in focus after third quarter results showed higher net income and earnings per share than a year earlier, followed by a lift to 2026 profit guidance and fresh ETF inflows. That stronger outlook has landed in a mixed tape for American Express, with the share price returning 6.71% over the past 30 days but declining 4.68% over 90 days and falling 12.81% year to date. Recent ETF net buying and raised 2026 guidance point to improving sentiment in the short term...
